name: Colonel Fanshawe's handkerchief
note: EXTRACTED from docs/23-inventory-act1.md (Act II items) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 23 and re-run. Pocketed absently at A10. Kept. Room 11's own handkerchief is hidden once it is taken. Errata 66 ruling A: shown to the character at C5 and kept; never consumed.

LOOK_AT.say: Colonel Fanshawe's handkerchief. I do not remember taking it. I remember him pressing it on me, and then I remember the street.
repeat: I have wiped nothing with it. It is not the kind of thing that wipes.
I should give it back. He would refuse, warmly, and I would leave with something else of his.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It is too fine to make a sound in a pocket.
repeat: A faint smell of his cigars. It is still working for him.
